invented_facts: The Aurora 14 can lower the firm's cloud bill or replace ongoing subscription fees.
Approving pilot units now would mean deployment before the Q1 budget window closes.
Client drawings are locked behind a firewall when engineers use cloud workstations.
Engineers can annotate drawings, run simulations, and access project files offline on the Aurora 14.
Data never leaves the device unless the user chooses to sync it, and using the device improves the firm's security posture.
The Aurora 14's storage is user-upgradeable; the spec sheet confirms two M.2 slots but only explicitly calls memory user-upgradeable.
Waiting would lock in current cloud costs for another year.
notes: The sequence covers the requested progression and speaks to Morgan's priorities, but it repeatedly presents assumptions as facts. Emails 1 and 2 exceed 120 words, and email 3 offers two ways to act rather than exactly one call to action.
